semantics.definition: A functional wrap-front upper garment formed by two separately traceable front panels crossing diagonally, with one panel continuing beneath the other and a side tie, button, or fixed seam holding the overlap. The crossing creates a coherent wrap V neckline and edge path rather than a decorative diagonal print, faux seam, or loose scarf.
paraphrase_examples: 두 앞판이 사선으로 실제 겹치고 한쪽이 아래로 이어져 옆에서 고정되는 블라우스
two traceable front edges cross into a functional side fastening and wrap V neckline
the lower panel remains visible beneath the upper panel through fold depth and edge continuity

left and right fronts cross as distinct fabric panels

fold depth proves a real diagonal overlap

the crossing edges form a coherent wrap V neckline
neckline and diagonal overlap share the same edge path
교차 가장자리가 하나의 랩 V 네크라인을 형성
a side tie button or fixed seam holds the overlap
the fastening connects both wrap panels under tension

a fixed V-neck top with one decorative side bow

composition_instruction: Frame the torso and fastening side so both front-panel edges, their diagonal overlap depth, the wrap V neckline, and the functional tie, button, or seam remain readable together. Keep material folds coherent enough to disprove a printed or decorative false wrap.
